mapper.select: SELECT option_type AS type, option_id AS id, option_name AS name, category_path AS categoryPath, ignore_diet_match AS ignoreDietMatch FROM ( SELECT CONVERT('DISH' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS option_type, d.id AS option_id, CONVERT(d.name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS option_name, CAST(NULL AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS category_path, 0 AS ignore_diet_match FROM dish d WHERE d.enabled = 1 AND d.name IS NOT NULL AND d.name != '' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('INGREDIENT' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, i.id, CONVERT(i.name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CAST(NULL AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CASE WHEN BINARY c.name = BINARY '调料' OR BINARY p.name = BINARY '调料' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dish_ingredient i LEFT JOIN dish_ingredient_category c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN dish_ingredient_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE i.enabled = 1 AND i.name IS NOT NULL AND i.name != '' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('INGREDIENT_TAG' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, t.id, CONVERT(t.name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CAST(NULL AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, 0 FROM dish_ingredient_tag t WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.name != '' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('INGREDIENT_CATEGORY' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, c.id, CONVERT(c.name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CONVERT(CONCAT(p.name, ' / ', c.name) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CASE WHEN BINARY c.name = BINARY '调料' OR BINARY p.name = BINARY '调料' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dish_ingredient_category c INNER JOIN dish_ingredient_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.level = 2 AND c.enabled = 1 AND p.enabled = 1 AND c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name != '' UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('DISH_TAG' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, t.id, CONVERT(t.name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CAST(NULL AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, 0 FROM dish_tag t WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL AND t.name != '' ) options ORDER BY option_type, option_name, option_id
